variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Prefer 'const' by default, use 'let' for reassignable variables. Avoid 'var'.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: TypeScript includes standard JS types plus bigint and strict null checks.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Always use strict equality '===' and '!=='. Nullish coalescing '??' is preferred over '||' for defaults.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Standard if/else syntax. Ternary operators are common for simple conditional assignments.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: Use 'for...of' to iterate over arrays and iterables. Avoid 'for...in' for arrays.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: Standard while and do-while loops. Ensure loop conditions will eventually evaluate to false.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Arrow functions are preferred for callbacks and functional programming. Always explicitly type parameters.

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Use 'type[]' syntax for simple types, 'Array<type>' for generics. Leverage map, filter, and reduce.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Use 'Record<K, V>' for plain objects. Use 'Map' when keys are unknown until runtime or non-string.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: In TypeScript 4.4+, caught errors are 'unknown' by default. Narrow the type with 'instanceof'.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: TypeScript provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: TypeScript supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: TypeScript provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: TypeScript converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: TypeScript represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: TypeScript formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: TypeScript branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: TypeScript defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: TypeScript iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: TypeScript organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: TypeScript stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: TypeScript groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: TypeScript tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: TypeScript organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
